providers.name: Yahoo Finance
providers.description: Live quotes for stocks, indices, FX, crypto, commodities and bond yields. No key.

providers.name: Frankfurter (ECB)
providers.description: Reference FX rates from the European Central Bank. No key.

providers.name: CoinGecko
providers.description: Crypto spot prices + 24h change across thousands of coins. No key.

providers.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
providers.description: US macro series from the St. Louis Fed (rates, credit spreads, CPI/PCE, payrolls, GDP, industrial production…). Works without a key via the public endpoint; a free key raises reliability + limits.

providers.name: BLS
providers.description: US Bureau of Labor Statistics — CPI components, unemployment, payrolls, earnings. A free key is strongly recommended: the shared no-key quota is perpetually exhausted, so series stay blank until you add one.

providers.name: BEA
providers.description: US Bureau of Economic Analysis — GDP and trade balances (NIPA).

providers.name: Prediction Markets (Polymarket + Kalshi)
providers.description: Polymarket + Kalshi event odds, order books & live streams in a dedicated pane (p in Markets — or enable here to jump in). No key to browse; Kalshi live streaming: forecast api-key set kalshi --pem-file <key.pem>

providers.name: Stooq
providers.description: Daily market history.

providers.name: World Bank
providers.description: Annual country comparisons across economics, population and health.

providers.name: IMF DataMapper
providers.description: Country macroeconomic estimates and projections; access may be restricted on some networks.
providers.access_note: Access returned HTTP 403 during qualification. No curated series are enabled; estimates and projections must not be treated as observed outcomes.

providers.name: Eurostat
providers.description: Official European statistics with explicit dataset dimensions and observation flags.

providers.name: European Central Bank
providers.description: Official euro reference exchange rates.
providers.access_note: Reference rates are daily publications, not executable prices.

providers.name: Central Bank of Brazil
providers.description: Official Brazilian policy and macroeconomic series from SGS.

providers.name: Open-Meteo
providers.description: Daily weather forecasts for chosen locations, with an upcoming seven-day window.
providers.access_note: Free API access is for non-commercial use. Commercial deployments require the provider’s licensed service. Forecast issue time is not supplied by the blended endpoint.

providers.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
providers.description: Official Australian statistics with versioned dataset and index-base bindings.

providers.name: Bank for International Settlements
providers.description: Comparable central-bank policy rates, with country-specific compilation definitions.

providers.name: Statistics Singapore
providers.description: Official Singapore monthly statistics with exact table and row bindings.

providers.name: Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics
providers.description: Official Brazilian statistics from SIDRA, with explicit territorial and unit metadata.

providers.name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
providers.description: Composite leading indicators with complete SDMX measurement and adjustment bindings.

providers.name: US National Weather Service
providers.description: Official active weather alerts, retaining severity, affected areas and effective/expiry times.
